title: I Thought Raising a Mythical Beast Would Be Easy, but Somehow I’ve Become the Laughingstock of the Kingdom
about:
Made for Pyweek 42 Borrowed Time by Team Chinkaraoshiman.

chis: story, planning, writing 

Apex: music, sound effects 

speedlimit35: art, music, code

title_logo.text: Would Be Easy, but Somehow I’ve Become the

note_title: MUSIC: 20260924 - gtr.mp3 plays on the title screen and until we change later. Is default BGM
note_stats: Start 4/4. A stat reaching 0 ends the game: Time = goat death, Reputation = exiled. 6 of 16 paths survive (3 true, 3 normal).

intro.note: ART: opening1-3.png (1280x720) intro slideshow, still placeholders. Plays over the title music.

intro.text:
BORROWED TIME

Intro: The Mythical Beast

intro.speaker: Claire
intro.note: ART: hall.png (yours). TODO: CG of Claire standing proudly in front of several noble friends MUSIC: 20260924 - band.mp3

intro.speaker: Claire
intro.text: Soon I shall display the greatest accomplishment the house of Claire in our history.

intro.speaker: Friend 2
intro.text: Have you finally bought that diamond necklace?

intro.speaker: Claire
intro.text: My knights have captured the mythical beast of the high peaks.

intro.speaker: Claire
intro.text: Under my orders, the finest knights of my dukedom have ventured to the highlights in search of it, and have informed me of wonderful news of its capture.

intro.speaker: Claire
intro.text: I shall tame this beast and keep it by my side to show the greatness of the house of Claire.

intro.speaker: Claire
intro.text: You all may see it early, but I intend to officially unveil it at next year’s Grand Ball.

intro.speaker: Claire (thinking)
intro.text: With this creature by my side, no one will ever look down on me again.

intro.speaker: Claire (thinking)
intro.text: By next year's Grand Ball, everyone in the kingdom will know my name.

intro.speaker: Claire
intro.text: Tell everyone that Lady Claire has tamed the grand beast of the mountains.

intro.speaker: Friend 2
intro.text: All of the lands shall know of your accomplishment!

intro.note: ART: knight.png (yours), shared by Knight 1 and Knight 2 MUSIC: silence

intro.text: A tiny, extremely derpy goat slowly walks into the room.

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: What is the meaning of this!
prologue.note: TODO ART: CG of Claire in a private room with her knights (hall.png for now) MUSIC: 20260924 - gtr.mp3

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: Do you mean to tarnish my reputation in front of all the kingdom!

prologue.speaker: Knight 1
prologue.text: No milady! the Royal Mage has confirmed it himself that this is the mythical beast of the mountains!

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: Does this look any bit mythical to you!

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: What could have caused it appear in such a manner!

prologue.speaker: Knight 2
prologue.text: Well uh…

prologue.speaker: Knight 2
prologue.text: Though it was in a weakened state, it appeared much more grand when we first laid our eyes on it.

prologue.speaker: Knight 2
prologue.text: Upon the chase, however, we may have driven it off a 50 foot cliff where it landed on its head.
The house doctor bursts into the room.

prologue.speaker: Doctor
prologue.text: Lady Claire, I am afraid that your beast may have severe brain damage!

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: Brain damage!

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: How severe?

prologue.speaker: Doctor
prologue.text: He may not survive more than a 3 months without supervision.

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: A month?!

prologue.speaker: Doctor
prologue.text: With proper care, perhaps a year.

prologue.speaker: Doctor
prologue.text: But know that, he'll be living on borrowed time.

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: To live on “Borrowed time”?

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: With this beast by my side, it is my reputation that shall be living on borrowed time.
Claire slowly turns toward the beast.

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: I see.

prologue.speaker: Claire (thinking)
prologue.text: A year.

prologue.speaker: Claire (thinking)
prologue.text: I need only to keep him alive for a year.

prologue.speaker: Claire (thinking)
prologue.text: Then I'll officially unveil him at the Grand Ball.

prologue.speaker: Claire (thinking)
prologue.text: Where everyone will marvel at my magnificent beast.

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: All right, you shall be named Excelsior, which means “forever upward”.

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: Together we will cement our status along with the great princes and rulers of this kingdom.
Excelsior walks directly into a wall.

prologue.speaker: Claire
prologue.text: This is going to be difficult.

ch1.note: MUSIC: bwv997g for this whole chapter

ch1.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch1.text: I've kept Excelsior locked up in a room to prevent it from hurting itself.

ch1.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch1.text: However, my dearest “friends” have demanded a tea party to have audience with the mythical beast.

ch1.speaker: Friend 1
ch1.text: Oh Lady Claire, we are dying to meet the mythical beast of the high peaks you have tamed.
Claire is visibly nervous with a bead of sweat on her forehead.
Claire nervously signals to a servant.

ch1.speaker: Claire
ch1.text: And please... keep the beast under control.
A moment later, the servant enters with Excelsior on the leash.

ch1.speaker: Claire
ch1.text: I do believe you mean majestic... right?
Excelsior stares at the burning oil lamp on the table.
Excelsior takes one step toward the lamp.
Excelsior suddenly CHARGES toward the table!
The startled servant drops the leash as the beast begins to dash towards you and your friends.

ch1_trust.speaker: Claire
ch1_trust.text: There is no need to worry.
The goat rams into the oil lamp on the table, causing adequate destruction in his path.

ch1_trust.speaker: Claire
ch1_trust.text: Uh…, this is normal behavior for highland beasts, they tend to seek out warmth due to the cold weather of their natural environment.

ch1_trust.speaker: Claire
ch1_trust.text: And that is why you are not an expert as I am.

ch1_trust.speaker: Claire
ch1_trust.text: I merely wanted to show you its natural behavior so you may understand the depth of knowledge required to tame such a beast.

ch1_trust.speaker: Friend 1
ch1_trust.text: I would have never thought such a thing!
You look at the flaming goat.

ch1_yeet.text: You lift your dress and charge straight at the goat.

ch1_yeet.speaker: Friend 1
ch1_yeet.text: Lady Claire, what are you doing!
You grab Excelsior by its horns.
You yeet Excelsior into the nearby bushes.

ch2.note: MUSIC: TODO pick a chapter 2 track (default BGM for now)

ch2.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch2.text: It has been 3 months since the tea party.
ch2.note: ART: courtyard.png (placeholder) = palace courtyard with a decorative stone pillar

ch2.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch2.text: As planned, word has spread about the mythical beast in my possession bringing me fame throughout the kingdom.

ch2.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch2.text: Though the attention has become a double edged sword as the prince has organized a meeting to see Excelsior for himself.
Claire walks into the courtyard with Excelsior on a leash awaiting the prince.

ch2.speaker: Claire
ch2.text: You be refined and dignified as a representative of the house of Claire.

ch2.speaker: Claire
ch2.text: I shall take that as an agreement.

ch2.speaker: Prince
ch2.text: It is a pleasure to finally meet you.

ch2.speaker: Claire
ch2.text: It's truly delightful to be in your presence.

ch2.speaker: Prince
ch2.text: And this must be the legendary beast I've heard so much about.
The prince bows again, revealing his fiery red hair to the beast.
Excelsior's eyes lock onto the Prince's bright red hair as if in a hypnotic trance.
You see it in Excelsior’s eyes.
He is going to headbutt the prince.

ch2_block.text: You take the headbutt directly in the corset and go down.
Excelsior and the prince are fine.

ch2_block.speaker: Prince
ch2_block.text: He seems rather pleased with himself.

ch2_block.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch2_block.text: And my prestige has been tarnished.

ch2_block.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch2_block.text: All because of this cursed goat!

ch2_block.speaker: Claire
ch2_block.text: I am in charge of taming this beast.

ch2_block.speaker: Prince
ch2_block.text: And show great care for this beast.

ch2_block.speaker: Claire
ch2_block.text: I care about keeping him alive.
Excelsior walks over and gently nudges Claire.

ch2_yank.text: You grab the leash and yank.
Excelsior crashes into a decorative stone pillar.

ch2_yank.note: Bruised from the pillar, for the rest of this scene.

ch2_yank.speaker: Prince
ch2_yank.text: You stopped a charging beast with one pull.

ch2_yank.speaker: Noble 2
ch2_yank.text: Lady Claire must be incredibly strong.

ch3.note: MUSIC: TODO pick a chapter 3 track (default BGM for now)

ch3.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch3.text: After all that has happened, I deserve a spa day all to myself.

ch3.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch3.text: No parties, no Princes, and most of all…

ch3.speaker: Claire
ch3.text: Ensure that no one disturbs me within the next hour.
Claire relaxes in a luxurious sauna.
The door crashes open revealing a very determined looking goat.

ch3.speaker: Claire
ch3.text: How did you even get here?!
Excelsior looks toward the sauna and sees the burning charcoals.
You already know what is going to happen.

ch3.note: TODO: script's choice A heading says Time -1 / Rep +1 but its footer says Time +1 / Rep -1. Using the heading.

ch3_maids.text: Excelsior charges into the sauna and lays atop the burning coals-

ch3_maids.speaker: Claire
ch3_maids.text: Remove him from the coals at once!
The maid struggles to pull Excelsior off of the coals.
He appears to be a lot stronger than she anticipated.
You pour tub water on Excelsior and the coals, extinguishing the goat.
Excelsior, now disinterested, walks towards Claire.

ch3_maids.speaker: Claire
ch3_maids.text: Why does he always look so pleased with himself?

ch3_maids.speaker: Claire
ch3_maids.text: For a beast with severe brain damage, he sure has vast knowledge on making me worry!

ch3_save.text: Excelsior digs his hooves into the floor.
You and Excelsior both fly back through the broken door and into the hallway.
A hallway filled with maids and servants stare at you, wearing nothing but a towel.

ch4.note: MUSIC: bwv997g for this whole chapter

ch4.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch4.text: Nobles from every corner of the kingdom had gathered tonight.

ch4.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch4.text: And tonight, I would finally unveil my magnificent mythical beast for all to see!

ch4.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch4.text: Though I do believe, word has already spread far and wide.
Claire looks down at Excelsior on a leash.
Claire enters the ballroom with Excelsior.

ch4.speaker: Friend 1
ch4.text: Everyone has been talking about your mythical beast.

ch4.speaker: Friend 2
ch4.text: I can't believe you managed to keep him alive this long.

ch4.speaker: Claire
ch4.text: It was difficult work, but I can accomplish anything in the name of the House of Claire!

ch4.speaker: Claire
ch4.text: The most startling thing though is his strange fixation to fire.

ch4.speaker: Friend 1
ch4.text: Then tonight will be delightful for him!

ch4.speaker: Friend 1
ch4.text: Why, this year's theme for the Grand Ball is the “Festival of Flames”!
As if right on cue, the Royal Mage ignites the grand bonfire, creating the largest, most magnificent orange blaze you have set your eyes upon.
ch4.note: ART: festival.png (placeholder) = the ballroom with the grand bonfire lit MUSIC: 2026092423_osdyspdup.mp3 Middle slot stays empty from here so the fire is visible (friends/nobles speak name-only).

ch4.text: You stare at the flames in a hypnotic trance until you remember your strange fire loving beast.
You look down but it is too late.
Excelsior bolts faster than ever before, snapping the leash right out of your hands.
Excelsior disappears into the roaring flames.

options.text: Dive into the flame! Save Excelsior!
Let it happen. It's what he's always wanted

ch4.note: TODO: 'Let it happen' heading says Rep +1 but its footer says Rep +3. Using the heading (+1).

ch4_dive.text: Claire throws herself into the flames.
Claire emerges from the fireplace, covered in soot, clutching Excelsior.

ch4_dive.speaker: Claire
ch4_dive.text: You could have really died this time!
Her beautiful gala dress is covered in soot and ash.

ch4_dive.speaker: Claire
ch4_dive.text: There are things that are more important than what others think.

ch4_dive.speaker: Claire
ch4_dive.note: TODO: script says [FADE OUT.] here. The engine has no fade yet.

ch4_let.speaker: Friend 2
ch4_let.text: Claire?!

ch4_let.speaker: Friend 2
ch4_let.text: He's in the fire!

ch4_let.speaker: Claire
ch4_let.text: I am aware.

ch4_let.speaker: Friend 2
ch4_let.text: Why aren't you doing anything?!

ch4_let.speaker: Claire
ch4_let.text: Because...
Claire looks into the flames.

ch4_let.speaker: Claire
ch4_let.text: He's been doing this his entire life.

ch4_let.speaker: Claire
ch4_let.text: Every fire he saw...

ch4_let.speaker: Claire
ch4_let.text: He always ran toward it and seemed to enjoy it.

ch4_let.speaker: Friend 2
ch4_let.text: We all know he isn’t a mythical beast!

ch4_let.speaker: Friend 2
ch4_let.text: He's just a goat, he’s not thinking straight!
Claire clenches her fists.

ch4_let.speaker: Claire
ch4_let.text: I've spent months assuming he wasn’t the brightest.

ch4_let.speaker: Claire
ch4_let.text: But maybe...

ch4_let.speaker: Claire
ch4_let.text: I should put more trust in him.
The flames suddenly flare and a loud screeching sound is heard from the flames.
A large white worm monster appears from the flames, screeching!
ch4_let.note: ART: worm.png (placeholder sprite) = large white brain-eating worm monster

ch4_let.speaker: Royal Mage
ch4_let.text: By god!

ch4_let.speaker: Royal Mage
ch4_let.text: That is the mythical brain eating parasitic worm as told of in the ancient texts!
The monster escapes the flames, where it is cut down by a nearby knight.
The fire begins to die down.
ch4_let.note: MUSIC: gtr (calm returns as the fire dies) ART: festival2.png dissolves in as the fire dies.
Stat check before the goat walks out: if Time hit 0 he doesn't survive the fire (Goat Killer).

ch4_let_survived.text: A silhouette appears inside the fireplace.
Excelsior walks out of the flames.

ch4_let_survived.speaker: Claire
ch4_let_survived.text: You were trying to get rid of something this whole time!

ch4_let_survived.speaker: Claire
ch4_let_survived.text: The fire was helping you all this time.

ch4_let_survived.speaker: Noble 2
ch4_let_survived.text: She must have known about the parasite this whole time!

ch4_let_survived.speaker: Friend 1
ch4_let_survived.text: Claire, everyone is looking at you!
ch4_let_survived.note: TODO: script just says FRIEND here. Using Friend 1.

ch4_let_survived.text: Everyone is staring at her in awe.

ch4_let_survived.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch4_let_survived.text: This is the moment I've been waiting for.

ch4_let_survived.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch4_let_survived.text: The entire kingdom is watching to see the greatness of the House of Claire.

ch4_let_survived.speaker: Claire (thinking)
ch4_let_survived.text: And somehow… it does not matter as much to me anymore.

ch4_let_survived.note: TODO: script says [FADE OUT.] after this line. The engine has no fade yet. MUSIC: 20260924 - band.mp3

finale.note: Ending is picked by the chapter 4 choice. If a stat has reached 0 you get that death instead (checked first).

normal_end.text: After saving Excelsior from the flames, Claire and Excelsior went back to the house of Claire appearing broken, but sharing a stronger bond than ever before.
normal_end.note: ENDING — A LIFE WORTH SAVING. ART: ending_normal.png. MUSIC: TODO (default BGM for now)

normal_end.text: However, as the house doctor stated, Excelsior's condition continued to worsen over the coming months.
But for the remaining time they had together, Claire stayed by his side.
Her reputation never fully recovered, but it mattered to her no longer.
…Perhaps there is another way to save him.

true_end.text: The fire had burned away the parasite eating away at Excelsior’s brain.
true_end.note: TRUE ENDING — BORROWED TIME. ART: ending_true_1.png

true_end.text: Excelsior was no longer living on borrowed time as the parasite that plagued him was gone, and for the first time in his life, he was truly free to live with Claire.
Story of the house of Claire and their mythical beast defeating a monster is spread through the kingdom, bringing much pride and prosperity to the Dukedom.
As it turns out, however, the mythical beast the royal mage had sensed was from the parasite, not Excelsior himself.

goat_death.text: Excelsior had run out of his “borrowed time” as he succumbed to his injuries.
goat_death.note: GOAT KILLER ENDING. Plays when Time reaches 0. ART: game_over_goat_1.png, then _2

goat_death.text: As word spread of the House of Claire’s mythical beast, alongside was the word of its death from your sheer unadulterated negligence.
Perhaps it was not the goat's mind that was the problem.
Perhaps you are simply bad at taking care of goats.

goat_death.hint: Hint: Perhaps you should have cared more for your beast.

rep_death.text: A royal envoy appears at the residence of the House of Claire.
rep_death.note: EXILED ENDING. Plays when Reputation reaches 0. ART: game_over_rep.png

rep_death.text: Word of your unruliness has spread to every corner of the kingdom, and they have had enough.
You have brought too much shame and embarrassment upon your household, and the royal decree has stripped you of your noble title and exiled you from the kingdom.
You’ve lost your Nobility, Residence, but at least you still had your goat.

rep_death.hint: Hint: To care for your beast is honorable. But you must guard your reputation just as fiercely as you guard your goat.
